FOOTNOTES

1/ The appropriation is exempt from the provisions of section 35-190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to lapsing of appropriations. (FY 2025 General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$2,120,500 and 13 FTE Positions from the Dental Board Fund in FY 2026 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2025.

Annual Leave Payout

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2026 for an Annual Leave Payout. Adjustments are as follows:

Remove One-Time Payout

The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(9,300) from the Dental Board Fund in FY 2026 to remove a one-time annual leave payout. The FY 2025 budget included a footnote making these monies non-lapsing.
